release.badVersion: "{version}" is not a usable version name (letters, digits, . _ + - only)
release.badRef: Unknown git ref "{ref}"; nothing was written
release.noMarkers: {file} exists but has no crew:conclusion markers; it was not written. Use --force to replace it.
release.todo: TODO: write the conclusion - what was verified, what was not, which assumptions stand.
release.todoWarn: Warning: the conclusion in {file} is still a TODO; write it before the release is committed (--conclusion-file).
release.title: Release {version}
release.noTasks: No merged task could be tied to this range.
release.notPlaced: Not placed (merged between the two refs' dates, but no commit of the range matches)
release.noReview: NO REVIEW: this task has no finalized review round.
release.stale: NOT RE-REVIEWED: the task was returned again after the last finalized review round (round {round}); its last changes were not re-reviewed.
release.noPlans: No plan is linked to the included tasks.
release.noUserTurn: NO USER TURN: the answer does not count as approval
release.missing: gate.missing ({gate}): the action ran without a recorded approval
